source_title: Haryana company surprises four employees with brand-new cars for their dedication - India Today
source_excerpt:
MITS Healthcare founder gifted Kia Sonet cars to four employees. The gesture recognised their dedication, contributions and loyalty to the company.
A Haryana-based founder gifted four employees brand-new Kia Sonet cars as a token of appreciation for their hard work and loyalty towards the company.
Mits Healthcare Pvt Ltd shared pictures and videos of the celebration on its Instagram account, showing founder and chairperson MK Bhatia presenting the cars to the employees.
In the pictures, the employees were seen posing alongside Bhatia and unveiling their new vehicles. The celebrations also included cake-cutting, cheering and plenty of smiles as the recipients marked the occasion.
According to the company, the four employees who received the cars were Nitin, Nirmal, Venus and Gurvir. The gesture was meant to recognise their dedication, contributions and achievements at MITS Group of Companies.
In its caption, the company described the occasion as a celebration of appreciation and recognition, adding that it believed in valuing the people behind its growth and success.
